item.description: The unauthorized excursion on Dec. 17 left a five-mile scar across the federally protected wilderness, threatening plant species found nowhere else on the planet.

item.title: More than 300 hospital workers strike in Orange County
item.description: More than 300 union caregivers, including nurses, therapists, and housekeepers, are currently on a three-day strike at two Kindred hospitals in Westminster and Brea.
